## Homage (English)<a id="homage-english"></a>

Homage to the Blessed One.

## Vinaya<a id="vinaya"></a>

Before use, say:

'Imaṁ *saṅghāṭiṁ* adhiṭṭhāmi.'\
'*I determine this outer robe.*'

Then: 'Imaṁ pattaṁ adhiṭṭhāmi.'
